text: uh ok so camera, we have spinny mode and we have move around mode but no angle(?) mode? like uh, hm, i want to be able to like level out my view, if that makes sense. [Image #31] like get less of a birds-eye view or more of a birds eye view (both ways)
resolution: Added camera tilt to the map editor's iso view: the framework Isometric camera rig gained an optional pitch parameter (omitting it keeps the true-iso 35.264° lock, so no other consumer changes), and the editor's IsoStage now carries pitch in its pose with a pitchBy() clamped to 12°-80° — low enough to nearly level out with the horizon, high enough for a near-plan bird's-eye, but shy of straight-down where the yaw basis degenerates and the host brush ray bails. Driven two ways: vertical middle-drag tilts while horizontal still spins yaw (one orbit gesture, matching mesh-studio feel), and ctrl+wheel steps 3° per notch (req_2711's ask) while plain wheel keeps zoom-to-cursor. All TS-side — hot reload picks it up, no rebuild.
